items.title: George Williams Interview, 1959-03-17
items.q: Big I Lloyd piano player. I used to play with him mostly all the time.

ctx.x: Well I thought you meant you played house parties with a piano player.

I'd take lessons, no. You see, at that time when they had parties, people put on parties, well they'd have a drum and a piano, which would be a band. Well they didn't have nothing other than that. They always had a drum and a piano. And that went big. Sometimes they'd have four or five parties in the block. Well whoever would be playing, they'd say George William was playing so and so. Another piano player would be great, he'll be playing somewhere else. Big I Lloyd piano player. I used to play with him mostly…
Same place I guess I've heard of before. Several people told us they went there.
